audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart says Mel wins Level 1 and Mel wins 2+ items, while the packet chart says Skill at Level 1 and Urgot at 2+ items, and every prose string says Urgot stays dominant late at a 58.44% win rate.
audit.why: Level 1 Urgot has Corrosive Charge (Q, 800 range, 10s) and Echoing Flames chip; Mel has Radiant Volley (Q, 950, 10s) — a poke-vs-poke standoff, not a Mel win. At two items Urgot's Purge shred plus the Fear Beyond Death execute beats a squishy artillery mage with no dash.
audit.corrected: Row 0 = Skill (5/10), Row 6 = Urgot (7/10); both layers flipped in one atomic group.

audit.why: Spikes read Lvl 3-5 (full kit online), Lvl 6 (execute), 1st item (Black Cleaver), Late — matches Urgot's real curve. Only the Level 6 text needed the Rebuttal correction.
audit.corrected: Kept the four spike windows; corrected spikes[1].text so the level-6 spike is conditional on Rebuttal being down.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1].text claims Rebuttal 'only blocks one instance, and your execute threshold ignores it'. Riot's text for Rebuttal: it reflects enemy projectiles back at the attacker and prevents her from taking damage for its duration.
audit.why: Corrosive Charge (Q) and Fear Beyond Death (R) are both projectiles. Firing either into an active Rebuttal wastes it and sends it back. Rebuttal is 38s at rank 1 versus Q at 10s and R at 100s — the barrier is the cooldown that decides the all-in, not Solar Snare alone.
audit.corrected: Bait Rebuttal (38s at rank 1) with an auto or Q, then flip with Disdain (E, 16s) and fire R once it drops. Solar Snare (E) is 11s at rank 1 — that is the poke cooldown; Rebuttal is the commit cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns named only Solar Snare with no number.
audit.why: The packet flags zero sequencing cues in this matchup.
audit.corrected: Solar Snare 11s at rank 1, Rebuttal 38s at rank 1 — both now stated with the ordering of the commit.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing mentions Searing Brilliance (P): every ability Mel casts loads three bonus projectiles onto her next attack, and Overwhelm stacks feed Golden Eclipse (R, 120s at rank 1) at unlimited range.
audit.why: The wind-up on the loaded attack is the burst tell, and Overwhelm stacks banked in lane can execute later from across the map.
audit.corrected: Noted; not written into a field this pass because the applicable strings were already at length.
